description: Baluchistan Wheels Limited manufactures automotive wheel rims for trucks, buses, tractors, cars and mini commercial vehicles. Incorporated in 1980, it runs a plant on the Main RCD Highway at Hub Chowki with heavy and light duty rim lines, presses up to 1,500 tons, a press line, assembly and welding, and cathodic electro-deposition painting, and has raised annual capacity from one million to 2.5 million wheels.
headOffice: 1st Floor, State Life Building No. 3, Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed Road, Karachi, Pakistan
